writing.overall_comment: A well-organized conceptual overview with accurate naming and reusable template scaffolds, but it lacks concrete worked examples and executable steps that would make the skill directly actionable.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately capture a full-lifecycle product management skill (discovery, prioritization, strategy, PRD), though the description is verbatim-duplicated in the frontmatter and body.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Only empty templates are provided (user story, PRD structure) with no filled-in worked examples, no anti-patterns, and no failure or edge-case handling.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: Frameworks like RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, and WSJF are named but never explained or given step-by-step procedures, leaving the reader to know how to apply them already.

suggestions: In the user story and PRD template sections, add fully filled-in worked examples, anti-patterns, and explicit edge/failure cases so the examples section shows expected outputs and boundary handling.

In the framework descriptions for RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, and WSJF, add step-by-step application procedures with inputs, scoring/calculation steps, and short worked examples so readers can apply them without prior knowledge.
